In the ancient Indian epic, the Mahabharata, King Yudhishthira experienced a profound sense of despair and survivor's guilt after a traumatic event. Remember, it's okay to take things one step at a time and to be patient with yourself as you navigate through this challenging time. You are strong, and you have the ability to cope and grow from this experience.

Wishing you all the best on your journey towards healing and growth.
